events.address: Union Square Plaza, Broadway between E 17th & E 18th St, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile scalp-and-hair-care lab where visitors can explore Dr. Groot's scalp-first hair-care science, fragrances and products.
events.what_is_free: Public entry and product exploration are free; current listings describe the activation as open to the public.
events.caveats: Current NYC for FREE and Average Socialite listings agree that the activation is open to the public at Union Square Plaza. The date-specific hours differ by day: September 16 is 11 AM–7 PM and September 17 is 11 AM–5 PM. No advance RSVP requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public activation. Use the occurrence-specific hours rather than treating the two-day range as one continuous event.

events.what_it_is: A one-day Krave Beauty takeover at Go Greek Yogurt celebrating Mochi Berrier Moisture Cream with a limited-edition smoothie, typewriter poetry, a DJ and brand-team meet-and-greet.
events.what_is_free: RSVP is free. Personalized poetry is offered while available. A full-size Mochi Berrier Moisture Cream requires purchase of the Berrier Bounce smoothie and is while supplies last; the first 30 eligible Reset Room members using the code word can receive a floral arrangement.
events.caveats: The live Partiful page is the stronger timing source and currently shows 4–6 PM, while one secondary listing shows 4–5 PM. Use 4–6 PM. The Partiful guest list is active. The free full-size cream is not a no-purchase giveaway; it requires a smoothie purchase and is while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Wednesday, September 16, 4–6 PM. Free RSVP is currently actionable through the live Partiful page.

events.event_name: goop kitchen Downtown Brooklyn VIP Preview
events.what_it_is: A pre-opening preview for goop kitchen's Downtown Brooklyn location offering complimentary lunch or dinner for pickup or delivery on September 16–17.
events.what_is_free: A complimentary preview meal for selected available pickup/delivery slots after signup.
events.caveats: The signup form is live and states that the preview meal is complimentary and spots are limited. Signup is required before the user is notified to select an available pickup or delivery slot. A submitted form should not be represented as guaranteed meal availability until a slot is actually selected/confirmed.
events.practical_notes: Preview runs September 16–17. Current event listing gives a 1–8 PM window; signup is actionable now, but individual meal-slot availability is limited.

events.what_it_is: NAYA's Park Slope grand opening celebration for its 50th location.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 guests receive a free bowl, roll or salad. After the first 100, bowls, rolls and salads are $5 for the day; separate promotional discounts are also advertised.
events.caveats: Average Socialite and NYC for FREE agree on Wednesday, September 16, 10:30 AM–9 PM at 311 7th Avenue and describe it as open to the public. The free-meal offer is limited to the first 100 guests and may be exhausted before closing.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in. Do not imply the free meal lasts all day; only the first 100 guests receive it.

events.what_it_is: A free cat-themed bodega pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats with product sampling, games, photo moments and merchandise prizes.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS Classic Treats and Lickable Puree samples; games offer chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise.
events.caveats: The official TEMPTATIONS announcement says the physical pop-up is free and runs September 17–19 from noon–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. Some secondary calendars list 216 Bowery; the first-party address of 213 Bowery is used here.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public pop-up, noon–6 PM each day September 17–19. Treat samples and merchandise prizes as availability-dependent.

events.event_name: CookUnity — The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Five locations: 873 Broadway; 266 W 23rd St; 369 Madison Ave; 275 W 4th St; 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas and delis where eight chefs serve complimentary chef-made lunches.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made meals and hot bites while supplies last, plus bodega-style scratch-off tickets with chances to win additional CookUnity meals and restaurant experiences.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources agree on Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM and five Manhattan locations. Meals are while supplies last and lines are expected. No RSVP requirement is published. Note: the main-source field should be replaced with a CookUnity-owned event URL if one becomes available; current verification relies on NYC for FREE, Time Out, Cititour and same-day press coverage.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in at any of the five participating bodegas. Arrive early because complimentary meals are explicitly while supplies last.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown — The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle Newsstand, 9th Ave between W 14th & W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A Bobbi Brown beauty newsstand takeover centered on Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with sampling, drinks, pastries, scratch-off giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: A VEFB+ sample, grapefruit Spindrift, mini croissant and scratch-off giveaway card are advertised; select scratch-off winners receive full-size product.
events.caveats: Current event listings publish Thursday, September 17, noon–6 PM at the Chelsea Triangle Newsstand. No advance RSVP requirement or purchase requirement is published for the sampling/newsstand experience. Giveaway quantities may be limited.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in newsstand activation, Thursday September 17, noon–6 PM.
